name: Accounting Statement Of Holdings 2
definition: Information about an accounting statement of holdings.

StatementGeneralDetails.name: Statement General Details
StatementGeneralDetails.definition: General information related to the custody statement of holdings that is being cancelled.

AccountDetails.name: Account Details
AccountDetails.definition: The safekeeping or investment account of the statement that is being cancelled.

BalanceForAccount.name: Balance For Account
BalanceForAccount.definition: Net position of a segregated holding, in a single security, within the overall position held in a securities account.

SubAccountDetails.name: Sub Account Details
SubAccountDetails.definition: The sub-account of the safekeeping or investment account.

Extension.name: Extension
Extension.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

BalanceForAccountOrSubAccountDetailsRule.definition: If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then either BalanceForAccount or SubAccountDetails is mandatory. If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then BalanceForAccount and SubAccountDetails may be present.
